data.one_liner: A customizable code field widget supporting syntax highlighting and code folding.
data.what_it_does: Flutter Code Editor provides a multi-platform code editing widget with support for syntax highlighting across over 100 languages, code folding, autocompletion, named sections, and read-only code blocks. It also includes pluggable analyzers for error highlighting.
use_when: You need an in-app code editor or text area with syntax highlighting.
You want to support code block folding and read-only sections for educational apps.
You need autocompletion and basic code analysis capabilities inside Flutter.
avoid_when: You only need a simple, single-line text input field.
You require a full-fledged IDE-level code editor with deep semantic analysis and multi-file project management.
strengths: Supports syntax highlighting for over 100 languages via the highlight package.
Includes advanced features like code folding, named sections, and read-only blocks.
Pluggable analyzers support local checks and DartPad integration.
weaknesses: Autocompletion uses an unstructured dictionary without deep syntax analysis.
Code analysis features are considered experimental and may introduce breaking changes.
